camps.name: Hale Day Camp
camps.description_short: Traditional outdoor day camp on Hale's 1,200 acres in Westwood with daily pond swim lessons, boating, archery, hiking, and ropes-course challenges in age-based units; campers ride Hale buses from surrounding towns.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Nonrefundable down payment per session ($300 two-week, $150 one-week); other payments refundable until March 20, 2026, then nonrefundable.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons from American Red Cross-certified Water Safety Instructors during two-week sessions; campers are swim-tested on day one. No lessons in the one-week Session 5.
camps.notes: 2026 season ran June 22-Aug 21 in mostly two-week sessions (Session 1 is 9 days, Session 5 is one week); per-session dates are no longer posted. CIT program for ages 14-15 ($2,295-$2,400). Buses serve Brookline, Dedham, Dorchester, Dover, Jamaica Plain, Medfield, Millis, Milton, Natick, Needham, Newton, Norwood, Roslindale, Walpole, Wellesley, West Roxbury, and Westwood.

sources.note: 2026 season; ages are Kindercamp through Teen Camp (CIT 14-15 excluded); price range is per session across camper units (sessions are mostly two weeks); page states Hale does not offer an extended day option; camp states ACA accreditation

camps.name: Natick Community Organic Farm Summer Programs
camps.description_short: Half-day morning or afternoon summer programs on a working organic farm in Natick, where children care for animals, plant and harvest crops, and play in the woods, grouped by age from preschool to young teens.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Written requests only: full refund less $35 per child per week before April 1, less $50 April 1-30; no refunds after May 1 (transfer may be offered).
camps.notes: Programs are half-day (AM or PM); families may book both but must pick up during the 12-1 pm lunch hour. Extended day only for ages 3-7. Prices are only shown in the Sawyer registration system and were not recorded; 2026 handbook lists no programs on June 19 and July 3.

sources.note: FAQ: summer programs for ages 3-15; extended day for ages 3-7; full and partial scholarships
2026 Summer Program Handbook (phone is option 1 for programs)

camps.name: Summer Barn Buddies
camps.description_short: Weekly morning farm program (9 am-1 pm) at Codman Community Farms in Lincoln where young children visit the chickens, pigs, cows, goats, and bunnies, help with chores, and work in the gardens.
camps.notes: Half-day (9:00 am-1:00 pm), rain or shine; 'best for ages 3-8'. Every 2026 week showed Sold out on the farm's store when checked (season over).

camps.name: Farmer, Forester, Chef! Camp
camps.description_short: Full-day camp at Powisset Farm in Dover where campers work with pigs, sheep, and goats, plant and harvest, cook in the farm's teaching kitchen, and hike Powisset's trails and nearby Noanet Woodlands.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Before April 1, tuition refunded less $175 per camper per week; no refunds after April 1. Session changes $75 per week if space allows.
camps.notes: Ages 6-11 all weeks; Teen Farm & Forest Stewards (ages 12-14) in Week 8 only. Week 8 (Aug 10-14) is a gluten-free cooking week.

sources.note: 2026 season; price_per_week is the nonmember rate, price_min the Trustees member rate; 9 am-3 pm. Campers bring their own lunch.

camps.refund_policy_summary: Before April 1, tuition refunded less $175 per camper per week; no refunds after April 1. Session changes $75 per week if space allows.
camps.notes: Ages 5-11 all 8 weeks; Teen Stewards on the Farm (ages 12-14) weeks 3-6 only. CIT program for ages 15-17.

sources.note: 2026 season; price_per_week is the nonmember rate, price_min the Trustees member rate; 9 am-3 pm.
